_schema.purpose: HTTP errors confirmed to be harmless background noise. They are never used to explain a failed test. Errors that are widespread in one night (many unrelated failures) are detected automatically and do not need an entry; add one here only after confirming an error is harmless. See docs/strategy/Test-Report-Dashboard-and-Triage-Plan.md §7.2.
_schema.endpointRegex: Regex on the templated path (ids shown as {id}), e.g. /procedureExecutions/latest$
_schema.reason: Why it is harmless and who confirmed it.
